response.sql:
WITH feature_records AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    traitcount,
    SUM(traitcount) OVER () as total_features,
    COUNT(*) OVER () as record_count
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    traitcount,
    CAST(traitcount AS REAL) / CAST(total_features AS REAL) as share,
    1.0 / CAST(record_count AS REAL) as average_share
  FROM feature_records
)
SELECT 
  zoneref,
  traitcount,
  share,
  share - average_share as margin
FROM shares
WHERE share > average_share
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: "Average share across records" means the arithmetic mean of all individual record shares: (sum of all shares) / (count of records) = 1 / (count of records with non-null traitcount). This follows necessarily because all shares sum to exactly 1.
